summary: Marked increase in bilateral perihilar/basilar edema-like opacity with larger bilateral pleural effusions, greater on the left.

findings.rationale: Compared with the matched prior lungs, the current image shows substantially denser bilateral perihilar and lower-lung fluffy airspace/interstitial opacity, left greater than right; this exceeds the technical differences from portable AP positioning.

The current costophrenic angles are more blunted with larger dependent pleural fluid at both bases, especially the left retrocardiac base, after matching diaphragm and pleural margins to the prior study.
